arguments.claim: Art. 16(1) provides equality of opportunity in matters relating to employment or appointment to any office under the State, which does not extend to promotions of persons already employed

anchor.surface_text: Art. 16 1  of the Constitution is in these words- There shall be equality of opportunity for all citizens in matters relating to employment or appointment to any office under the State. The impugned provisions of the channel of promotion are in respect of promotion of persons already employed under the State and not in respect of the first employment under the State. If the equality of opportunity guaranteed to all citizens by Art. 16 1  does not extend to matters of promotion the petitioners contention that the provisions are void must fail at once.
